sentences.text:
Rahul Kushwaha vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 October,
2025

Bench: Vivek Agarwal
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
 Cra No. 12154 of 2024
 (Rahul Kushwaha And Others Vs The State Of Madhya Prade
 Dated : 06-10-2025
 Shri Ram Prakash Yadav - Advocate for the appellants.

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Shri S. K. Shrivastava - Government Ad
 respondents/State.

Heard on I.A. No.21163 of 2025, which is first application under Section 430(1) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to appellants No.1 Rahul Kushwaha and No.3 Rajnish Choudhary.

The appellants are aggrieved of the judgment dated 07/10/2024 passed by learned Special Judge,
POCSO Act and Third Additional Sessions Judge, District Umariya (M.P.), in Special Case No.20/2021, whereby the appellants have been convicted for offences under Section 376(D) of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 20 years with fine of Rs.1,000/- and in default of payment of fine amount further RI for 6 months.

entities.text: Third Additional Sessions Judge, District Umariya (M.P.)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellants submits that the appellants are innocent and have been falsely implicated in this case.

It is further submitted that the case of present appellants is on the same footing as that of co- accused Manu Kewat and Itrendra Singh, who have been enlarged on bail by this Court vide order dated 26/08/2025 passed in connected CRA No. 12154/2024 & CRA No.13554/2024 pointing out that the DNA report is positive only qua Vivek Yadav.
There are good chances of success in appeal.
The final disposal of the appeal would take considerable time.

He, therefore,
prays for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the appellants.
Learned Government Advocate opposes the prayer and prays for dismissal of the same.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record as also maintaining principle of parity, without commenting on the merits of the case, we are of the considered opinion that this is a fit case to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the appellants and to release them on Rahul Kushwaha vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185572940/
1 bail.

entities.text: Rahul Kushwaha vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, I.A. No.21163 of 2025 is allowed.

It is directed that on depositing of the fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/-
(Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) each with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on 15/12/2025 and on all subsequent dates as may be fixed by the concerned Court, the execution of remaining part of jail sentence of appellants No.1 Rahul Kushwaha and No.3 Rajnish Choudhary shall remain suspended and they be released on bail till final disposal of this appeal.
List the matter along with CRA No. 13554 of 2024.
